description: Implementation of WorkerThread class managing a worker thread, task queue, and synchronization mechanisms within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: A class that manages a dedicated worker thread, task queue, and synchronization for executing tasks asynchronously.

classes.name: WorkerThreadFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating instances of WorkerThread.

methods.name: WorkerThread::WorkerThread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker thread and logs its start.

methods.name: WorkerThread::~WorkerThread
methods.description: Destructor that joins the worker thread if it is still running.

methods.name: WorkerThread::stop
methods.description: Stops the worker thread by setting the active flag to false.

methods.name: WorkerThread::join
methods.description: Joins the worker thread if it is joinable.

methods.name: WorkerThread::enqueueTask
methods.description: Enqueues a new task into the task queue and notifies the worker thread.

methods.name: WorkerThread::taskHandler
methods.description: Main loop of the worker thread that waits for and executes tasks.

methods.name: WorkerThread::waitForTask
methods.description: Waits for a task to be available in the queue and retrieves it.

methods.name: WorkerThreadFactory::createWorkerThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a new WorkerThread instance, with error handling.
